source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: When leaving a parked or stopped position, check your blind spots and mirrors and yield to all other traffic.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported claim about signaling not giving priority.

corrections.corrected_statement: Flaggers and automated flagger devices are what you meet on two-lane road work zones, while on freeways you usually keep moving through narrowed or shifted lanes.
corrections.note: The freeway driving-through portion appears on page 68, not page 67.

corrections.corrected_statement: At an office, authorized translators may enter the knowledge-test area, whereas a translator is never allowed inside the car during the drive test.
corrections.note: The drive-test translator ban is stated on page twelve, not the cited page ten.

corrections.corrected_statement: The online knowledge test must be taken on a desktop or laptop with keyboard, mouse and webcam, unlike the office test, which is given on a DMV touch-screen monitor.
corrections.note: The office touch-screen rule is stated on page ten, not the cited page eleven.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you take the vision test while wearing glasses or contact lenses, your driving privilege will show that corrective lenses are required.
corrections.note: Removed the claim that wearing lenses cannot cause failure because no page states it.

corrections.corrected_statement: Traction tires or chains, wipers, headlights, taillights and a defroster are required on the test vehicle only when the weather calls for them, unlike the always-required items such as brake lights and a horn.
corrections.note: The always-required brake lights and horn list is stated on page twelve, not the cited page thirteen.
